items.title: Smooth base change for a limit of smooth schemes and torsion coefficients invertible on the base
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file etale-cohomology.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261011
items.difficulty_reason: The lemma establishes base change for a quasi-compact quasi-separated morphism after base change to a directed limit of smooth schemes, for complexes whose coefficient stalks are torsion of invertible orders (statement lines 17974-17992). The proof (proof lines 17994-18011) compares the two spectral sequences of the complex, identifies their E_2 entries by smooth base change together with the limit case, and concludes for the abutments. H2: one spectral sequence comparison.
